_doc: Hub and landmark site prefabs on the walkable globe (SiteBuilders; built by the definition's sites_script). sites: [{id, kind (hub | landmark), name, size_m (pad diameter), clear_core_m (junk-free core, default 12), start_only (true: only hub 0 gets it; the other hubs cycle through the rest), desc}], hubs first. Optional: hub_pad_m (flat pad radius of hubs after the first, default 82), fill_pad (the builder gets the pad's flat radius as opts.flat), yard_keep_out (the start yard keeps junk off its pad piece by piece), api (a note on the script's entry point).

sites.desc: Hub 0: the landing yard (pod, broken workbench, trash bin) in a lived-in town.
Hubs 1 and up: a ruined town round the hub yard, seeded per hub.
